sloka: ततः तम् समनुज्ञाय गुहम् इक्ष्वाकु नन्दनः ।जगाम तूर्णम् अव्यग्रः सभार्यः सह लक्ष्मणः ॥२-५२-७३॥
transliteration: tataḥ tam samanujñāya guham ikṣvāku nandanaḥ ।jagāma tūrṇam avyagraḥ sabhāryaḥ saha lakṣmaṇaḥ ॥2-52-73॥

translations.english: Rama, Delight of the Iksvakus, then permitted Guha to take leave. And departed quickly with his consort and Lakshmana in peace.
